description: Fixed PolyBench/GPU 3D interior stencil: the pinned 15-term expression, including repeated offsets, with one independent 3D-grid launch. Preserves 25 volume sizes; output borders are initialized to zero before timing. Verifies every actual measured output afterward with a full CPU reference and emits raw timing plus fixed operator/verification identities.

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block dimension (3D block of block_size^3)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the untimed vector-add warmer before the measured stencil to raise clocks and disturb cache state; qualify the resulting state on the target. False disables the warmer.
